checks.name: Python 3.12
checks.hint: Instalar Python 3.12 e adicionar ao PATH.

test.name: Instalar dependências de teste
test.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Instalar dependências de build
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install --upgrade pip; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & '%PYTHON%' -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

build.name: Criar Talude V1 Windows
build.command: & '%PYTHON%' -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --windowed --noupx --name Talude_V1 --distpath '%WORK%/dist' --workpath '%WORK%/pyinstaller' --specpath '%WORK%' --paths '%REPO%/src' --hidden-import laspy --hidden-import laspy.lasreader --hidden-import laspy.laswriter --hidden-import lazrs --collect-all scipy --collect-all ezdxf '%REPO%/talude_gui.py'

build.name: Verificar executável
build.command: if (!(Test-Path '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1/Talude_V1.exe')) { throw 'Talude_V1.exe não foi gerado' }; Get-Item '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1/Talude_V1.exe' | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime

build.name: Self-test do executável
build.command: Push-Location '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1'; try { Remove-Item TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & ./Talude_V1.exe --self-test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; if (!(Test-Path './TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt')) { throw 'Self-test não criou relatório' }; Get-Content ./TALUDE_V1_SELF_TEST.txt } finally { Pop-Location }

build.name: Preparar pasta portátil
build.command: $pkg='%WORK%/package'; if (Test-Path $pkg) { Remove-Item $pkg -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $pkg | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse '%WORK%/dist/Talude_V1' ($pkg + '/Talude_V1'); Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/START_TALUDE_V1.bat' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'packaging/LEIA_ME.txt' $pkg; Copy-Item -Force 'README.md' $pkg
